fields.Name: IT45 - Embedding Invariants
fields.Description: Persisted-embedding invariants without model calls: stored vectors parse finite+dimensioned per (surface,model), no degenerate vectors, cross-entity dimensional agreement, stamped model resolution, LocalEmbeddings catalog shape. 5 checks (AE1-AE5), read-only, loud skips when no embeddings exist.
